heading_path: Division 3—Matters pending immediately before repeal of repealed Act
245  Application for registration of a mark in Part C of the old register
text: (1) Subject to Part 16, section 241 applies to an application for the registration of a mark as a certification trade mark in Part C of the old register as if the reference in subsection (1) to Part A or B of the old register were a reference to Part C of that register. (2) Subject to Part 16, sections 242 to 244 apply to an application for the registration of a mark as a certification trade mark in Part C of the old register. Note: For old register see section 6.
